exposure: nonfulfillment of desired postpartum permanent contraception
outcome: Number and timing of subsequent pregnancies
cohort: 1331 patients who had a documented contraceptive plan of female permanent contraception at time of postpartum discharge from 2012 to 2014
finding: Nonfulfillment of desired postpartum permanent contraception is associated with subsequent intrauterine pregnancies and short interpregnancy intervals, increasing the risk of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Patients who achieved permanent contraception fulfillment tended to have delivered more via cesarean delivery.
